icons.name: user
icons.heading: User
icons.description: The person perks up to say hello. Light: the shoulders crouch, the head pops up and lands back with a small bounce, and the shoulders stretch up with it and squash as it lands. Strong: a higher pop and a second hop at the back, each echoed by the front person a beat later. Heads stay round.

icons.name: key
icons.heading: Key
icons.description: The key unlocks. Light: the rigid key pushes in along its shaft and seats with a dead stop, turns on its inserted tip and stops with a click, then turns back and withdraws, quicker and smaller than the action. Strong: a short draw-back before a harder push that bounces on seating, a wider turn that clicks and rebounds, then the same quick return. The key never bends.

Strong: a deeper focus snap, the same steady pass, and on arrival the brackets squeeze once more to confirm the capture. The bar holds at the lower edge.
